p: men stood by him: That is, three angels in the shape of men.
Lord: Speaking to the one who appeared to be most majestic, for he thought they were men.
wash your feet: For men used to go bare footed in those parts because of the heat.
come to your servant: As sent by God that I should do my duty to you.
they did eat: For as God gave them bodies for a time, so he gave them the abilities of them, to walk, to eat and drink, and such like.
life: That is, about this time when she shall be alive, or when the child shall come into this life.
laughed within herself: For she believed the order of nature, rather than believing the promise of God.
LORD said: Jehovah the Hebrew word we call Lord, shows that this angel was Christ: for this word is only applied to God.
that he will command his children: He shows that fathers ought both to know God's judgments, and to declare them to their children.
go down now: God speaks after the fashion of men: that is, I will enter into judgment with good advise.
cry of it: For our sins cry for vengeance, though no one accuses us.

fifty righteous within the city: God declares that his judgments were done with great mercy, even though all were so corrupt that not only fifty but ten righteous men could not be found there, and also that the wicked are spared for the sake of the righteous.
but dust and ashes: By this we learn, that the nearer we approach to God, the more our miserable estate appears, and the more we are humbled.
once: If God did not refuse the prayer for the wicked Sodomites, even to the sixth request, how much more will he grant the prayers of the godly for the afflicted Church?
